stills.caption: Picking an apple up by Twiggy's house. Every bug, fish, fossil, shell and fruit you pick up goes in your field notes.
The next villager you talk to notices the find: a fruit you had never noted before, so your field notes grew a new page.
Then the villager carries on in their own words, as the game always has them.

film.caption: An apple is dropped from the pockets and picked up again, and Twiggy has something to say about the new page in your notes.
